CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_effective_product_process_route_steps(p_product_route_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_route_id bigint, effective_step_key text, sequence_no numeric, activity_id integer, cost_centre_id bigint, section_id integer, subsection_id integer, area_id integer, plant_id integer, behaviour_code text, resource_class_code text, route_step_scope text, expected_occurrence_count numeric, standard_cycle_count numeric, is_mandatory boolean, allows_repeat boolean, allows_skip_with_approval boolean, production_overhead_scope text, direct_labour_scope text, source_type text, base_step_id bigint, override_id bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with pr as (
  select r.*
  from costing.product_process_route r
  join costing.production_route_family_route fr on fr.id=r.base_route_family_route_id
  join costing.production_route_family f on f.id=fr.route_family_id
  where r.id=p_product_route_id
    and r.archived_at is null
    and fr.archived_at is null
    and f.archived_at is null
), base as (
  select s.*
  from pr
  join costing.production_route_family_route_step s
    on s.family_route_id=pr.base_route_family_route_id
), agg as (
  select o.base_step_id,
         bool_or(o.operation_type='BYPASS_STEP') bypassed,
         max(o.id) filter(where o.operation_type='REPLACE_STEP') replace_id,
         max(o.id) filter(where o.operation_type='ALTER_LOCATION') location_id,
         max(o.id) filter(where o.operation_type='ALTER_RESOURCE') resource_id,
         max(o.id) filter(where o.operation_type='ALTER_CYCLE') cycle_id,
         max(o.id) filter(where o.operation_type='ALTER_MANDATORY_STATUS') mandatory_id
  from costing.product_process_route_override o
  join pr on pr.id=o.product_route_id
  where o.base_step_id is not null
  group by o.base_step_id
), resolved_base as (
  select
    p_product_route_id product_route_id,
    b.step_key effective_step_key,
    coalesce(rep.sequence_no,b.sequence_no) sequence_no,
    coalesce(rep.activity_id,b.activity_id) activity_id,
    coalesce(rep.cost_centre_id,loc.cost_centre_id,res.cost_centre_id,b.cost_centre_id) cost_centre_id,
    coalesce(rep.section_id,loc.section_id,b.section_id) section_id,
    coalesce(rep.subsection_id,loc.subsection_id,b.subsection_id) subsection_id,
    coalesce(rep.area_id,loc.area_id,b.area_id) area_id,
    coalesce(rep.plant_id,loc.plant_id,res.plant_id,b.plant_id) plant_id,
    coalesce(rep.behaviour_code,res.behaviour_code,b.behaviour_code) behaviour_code,
    coalesce(rep.resource_class_code,res.resource_class_code,b.resource_class_code) resource_class_code,
    coalesce(rep.route_step_scope,b.route_step_scope) route_step_scope,
    coalesce(rep.expected_occurrence_count,cyc.expected_occurrence_count,b.expected_occurrence_count) expected_occurrence_count,
    coalesce(rep.standard_cycle_count,cyc.standard_cycle_count,b.standard_cycle_count) standard_cycle_count,
    coalesce(rep.is_mandatory,man.is_mandatory,b.is_mandatory) is_mandatory,
    coalesce(rep.allows_repeat,man.allows_repeat,b.allows_repeat) allows_repeat,
    coalesce(rep.allows_skip_with_approval,man.allows_skip_with_approval,b.allows_skip_with_approval) allows_skip_with_approval,
    coalesce(rep.production_overhead_scope,b.production_overhead_scope) production_overhead_scope,
    coalesce(rep.direct_labour_scope,b.direct_labour_scope) direct_labour_scope,
    case when coalesce(a.replace_id,a.location_id,a.resource_id,a.cycle_id,a.mandatory_id) is null then 'ROUTE_FAMILY' else 'PRODUCT_OVERRIDE' end source_type,
    b.id base_step_id,
    coalesce(a.replace_id,a.location_id,a.resource_id,a.cycle_id,a.mandatory_id) override_id
  from base b
  left join agg a on a.base_step_id=b.id
  left join costing.product_process_route_override rep on rep.id=a.replace_id
  left join costing.product_process_route_override loc on loc.id=a.location_id
  left join costing.product_process_route_override res on res.id=a.resource_id
  left join costing.product_process_route_override cyc on cyc.id=a.cycle_id
  left join costing.product_process_route_override man on man.id=a.mandatory_id
  where coalesce(a.bypassed,false)=false
), added as (
  select
    p_product_route_id product_route_id,
    o.override_step_key effective_step_key,
    o.sequence_no,o.activity_id,o.cost_centre_id,o.section_id,o.subsection_id,o.area_id,o.plant_id,
    o.behaviour_code,o.resource_class_code,o.route_step_scope,
    o.expected_occurrence_count,o.standard_cycle_count,o.is_mandatory,o.allows_repeat,o.allows_skip_with_approval,
    o.production_overhead_scope,o.direct_labour_scope,
    'PRODUCT_ADDED_STEP'::text source_type,
    null::bigint base_step_id,o.id override_id
  from costing.product_process_route_override o
  join pr on pr.id=o.product_route_id
  where o.operation_type='ADD_STEP'
)
select * from resolved_base
union all
select * from added
order by sequence_no,effective_step_key
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_product_process_route_readiness(p_as_of_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id integer, product_name text, category_id integer, category_name text, sub_category_id integer, subcategory_name text, product_group_id integer, product_group_name text, route_family_id bigint, route_family_code text, route_family_name text, product_route_id bigint, route_version integer, route_status text, effective_from date, effective_to date, evidence_status text, base_route_family_route_id bigint, batch_size_ref_id bigint, readiness_status text, validation jsonb, effective_family_route_id bigint, effective_route_source text, route_family_assignment_source text, product_route_family_assignment_id bigint, product_group_route_family_mapping_id bigint, route_family_assignment_basis text, route_family_assignment_approval_reference text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with ctx as (select coalesce(p_as_of_date,current_date) as as_of_date),
base as (
  select p.id product_id,p.item product_name,c.id category_id,c.category_name,
         sc.id sub_category_id,sc.subcategory_name,pg.id product_group_id,pg.group_name product_group_name,
         sg.id product_subgroup_id,
         costing.fn_resolve_route_family_for_product(p.id,(select as_of_date from ctx)) route_family_id
  from public.products p
  join public.sub_groups sg on sg.id=p.sub_group_id
  join public.product_groups pg on pg.id=sg.product_group_id
  join public.sub_categories sc on sc.id=pg.sub_category_id
  join public.categories c on c.id=sc.category_id
  where upper(coalesce(p.status,''))='ACTIVE'
), resolved as (
  select b.*,
         pa.id product_assignment_id,pa.assignment_basis product_assignment_basis,pa.approval_reference product_assignment_approval_reference,
         sm.id subgroup_mapping_id,sm.mapping_basis subgroup_mapping_basis,sm.approval_reference subgroup_mapping_approval_reference,
         gm.id group_mapping_id,gm.mapping_basis group_mapping_basis,gm.approval_reference group_mapping_approval_reference,
         rf.family_code,rf.family_name,
         fr.id family_route_id,
         pr.id product_route_id,pr.route_version,pr.status route_status,pr.effective_from,pr.effective_to,
         pr.evidence_status,pr.base_route_family_route_id,pr.batch_size_ref_id,
         costing.fn_validate_effective_product_process_route(b.product_id,(select as_of_date from ctx)) validation
  from base b
  left join lateral (
    select m.* from costing.production_route_family_product_map m
    where m.product_id=b.product_id and m.archived_at is null and m.status='APPROVED'
      and m.effective_from<=(select as_of_date from ctx)
      and (m.effective_to is null or m.effective_to>=(select as_of_date from ctx))
    order by m.effective_from desc,m.id desc limit 1
  ) pa on true
  left join lateral (
    select m.* from costing.production_route_family_product_subgroup_map m
    where m.product_subgroup_id=b.product_subgroup_id and m.archived_at is null and m.status='APPROVED'
      and m.effective_from<=(select as_of_date from ctx)
      and (m.effective_to is null or m.effective_to>=(select as_of_date from ctx))
    order by m.effective_from desc,m.id desc limit 1
  ) sm on true
  left join lateral (
    select m.* from costing.production_route_family_product_group_map m
    where m.product_group_id=b.product_group_id and m.archived_at is null and m.status='APPROVED'
      and m.effective_from<=(select as_of_date from ctx)
      and (m.effective_to is null or m.effective_to>=(select as_of_date from ctx))
    order by m.effective_from desc,m.id desc limit 1
  ) gm on true
  left join costing.production_route_family rf on rf.id=b.route_family_id and rf.archived_at is null
  left join lateral (
    select r.id from costing.production_route_family_route r
    where r.route_family_id=b.route_family_id and r.archived_at is null and r.status='APPROVED'
      and r.effective_from<=(select as_of_date from ctx)
      and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>=(select as_of_date from ctx))
    order by r.effective_from desc,r.route_version desc,r.id desc limit 1
  ) fr on true
  left join lateral (
    select r.* from costing.product_process_route r
    where r.product_id=b.product_id and r.archived_at is null and r.status='APPROVED'
      and r.effective_from<=(select as_of_date from ctx)
      and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>=(select as_of_date from ctx))
    order by r.effective_from desc,r.route_version desc,r.id desc limit 1
  ) pr on true
)
select product_id,product_name,category_id,category_name,sub_category_id,subcategory_name,product_group_id,product_group_name,
       route_family_id,family_code,family_name,product_route_id,route_version,route_status,effective_from,effective_to,evidence_status,
       base_route_family_route_id,batch_size_ref_id,
       case when route_family_id is null then 'BLOCKED_NO_APPROVED_ROUTE_FAMILY_MAPPING'
            when family_route_id is null then 'BLOCKED_NO_APPROVED_ROUTE_FAMILY_ROUTE'
            when not coalesce((validation->>'valid')::boolean,false) then 'BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE_PRODUCT_PROCESS_ROUTE'
            else 'READY' end readiness_status,
       validation,family_route_id,
       case when product_route_id is null then 'ROUTE_FAMILY_INHERITED' else 'PRODUCT_ROUTE' end effective_route_source,
       case when product_assignment_id is not null then 'PRODUCT_ASSIGNMENT'
            when subgroup_mapping_id is not null then 'PRODUCT_SUBGROUP_FALLBACK'
            when group_mapping_id is not null then 'PRODUCT_GROUP_FALLBACK' else 'NONE' end route_family_assignment_source,
       product_assignment_id,group_mapping_id,
       coalesce(product_assignment_basis,subgroup_mapping_basis,group_mapping_basis),
       coalesce(product_assignment_approval_reference,subgroup_mapping_approval_reference,group_mapping_approval_reference)
from resolved
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_product_sku_readiness_run_evidence(p_sku_id bigint, p_period_start date, p_valuation_date date, p_refresh_run_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with dl as (
 select * from costing.sku_direct_labour_allocation_snapshot where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id limit 1),
poh as (
 select * from costing.sku_production_overhead_allocation_snapshot where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id limit 1),
qc as (
 select * from costing.sku_qc_allocation_snapshot where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id limit 1),
ms as (
 select * from costing.sku_materials_stores_allocation_snapshot where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id limit 1),
af as (
 select * from costing.sku_admin_finance_overhead_allocation_snapshot where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id limit 1),
mk as (
 select * from costing.sku_marketing_expense_allocation_snapshot where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id limit 1),
scheme as (
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('region_code',region_code,'raw_status',resolution_status,'effective_status',resolution_status,'resolution_source',policy_source,'reason_code',resolution_status,'note',resolution_note,'evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('scheme_id',scheme_id,'policy_rule_id',policy_rule_id)) order by region_code),'[]'::jsonb) rows,
        count(*) n,
        bool_or(resolution_status not in ('RESOLVED','DEFAULT_NO_SCHEME')) bad
 from costing.sku_selected_scheme_policy_context_snapshot
 where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id),
regional as (
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('region_code',region_code,'raw_status',raw_status,'effective_status',effective_status,'resolution_source',regional_basis_source,'reason_code',regional_basis_status,'acceptance_eligible',is_acceptance_eligible,'accepted',is_accepted,'evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('regional_marketing_snapshot_id',regional_marketing_snapshot_id,'regional_basis_snapshot_id',regional_basis_snapshot_id,'acceptance_id',acceptance_id)) order by region_code),'[]'::jsonb) rows,
        count(*) n,
        bool_or(effective_status='BLOCKED') blocked,
        bool_or(effective_status='REVIEW_REQUIRED') review
 from costing.v_regional_marketing_evidence_review_queue
 where sku_id=p_sku_id and period_start=p_period_start and valuation_date=p_valuation_date and refresh_run_id=p_refresh_run_id)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'snapshot_present',coalesce((select true from dl),false) or coalesce((select true from poh),false) or coalesce((select true from qc),false) or coalesce((select true from ms),false) or coalesce((select true from af),false) or coalesce((select true from mk),false),
 'driver_dependencies',jsonb_build_array(
  jsonb_build_object('dependency_code','DIRECT_LABOUR','label','Direct Labour','scope','SKU_RUN','dimension','EVIDENCE_QUALITY','applicability','APPLICABLE','raw_status',coalesce((select direct_labour_allocation_status from dl),'UNKNOWN'),'effective_status',null,'resolution_source','RUN_SNAPSHOT','reason_code',(select allocation_reason_code from dl),'note',(select direct_labour_allocation_note from dl),'owner_module','PRODUCTION_ROUTE_MANAGER','recommended_ui_route','PRODUCTION_ROUTE_MANAGER','authority','costing.sku_direct_labour_allocation_snapshot','evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('snapshot_id',(select id from dl),'policy_id',(select policy_id from dl))),
  jsonb_build_object('dependency_code','PRODUCTION_OVERHEAD','label','Production Overhead','scope','SKU_RUN','dimension','EVIDENCE_QUALITY','applicability','APPLICABLE','raw_status',coalesce((select allocation_status from poh),'UNKNOWN'),'effective_status',null,'resolution_source','RUN_SNAPSHOT','reason_code',(select allocation_reason_code from poh),'note',(select allocation_note from poh),'owner_module','PRODUCTION_ROUTE_MANAGER','recommended_ui_route','PRODUCTION_ROUTE_MANAGER','authority','costing.sku_production_overhead_allocation_snapshot','evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('snapshot_id',(select id from poh),'policy_id',(select policy_id from poh))),
  jsonb_build_object('dependency_code','QUALITY_CONTROL_OVERHEAD','label','Quality Control Overhead','scope','SKU_RUN','dimension','EVIDENCE_QUALITY','applicability','APPLICABLE','raw_status',coalesce((select allocation_status from qc),'UNKNOWN'),'effective_status',null,'resolution_source','RUN_SNAPSHOT','reason_code',(select allocation_reason_code from qc),'note',(select allocation_note from qc),'owner_module','COST_SHEET_REVIEW','recommended_ui_route','QC_ACTION_QUEUE','authority','costing.sku_qc_allocation_snapshot','evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('snapshot_id',(select id from qc))),
  jsonb_build_object('dependency_code','MATERIALS_STORES_OVERHEAD','label','Materials / Stores Overhead','scope','SKU_RUN','dimension','EVIDENCE_QUALITY','applicability','APPLICABLE','raw_status',coalesce((select allocation_status from ms),'UNKNOWN'),'effective_status',null,'resolution_source','RUN_SNAPSHOT','reason_code',(select allocation_reason_code from ms),'note',(select allocation_note from ms),'owner_module','COST_SHEET_REVIEW','recommended_ui_route','MATERIALS_STORES_ACTION_QUEUE','authority','costing.sku_materials_stores_allocation_snapshot','evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('snapshot_id',(select id from ms))),
  jsonb_build_object('dependency_code','ADMIN_OVERHEAD','label','Administrative Overhead','scope','SKU_RUN','dimension','EVIDENCE_QUALITY','applicability','APPLICABLE','raw_status',coalesce((select admin_overhead_allocation_status from af),'UNKNOWN'),'effective_status',null,'resolution_source','RUN_SNAPSHOT','reason_code',(select allocation_resolution_status from af),'note',(select admin_overhead_allocation_note from af),'owner_module','COST_BUILD_MANAGER','recommended_ui_route','DRIVER_GOVERNANCE','authority','costing.sku_admin_finance_overhead_allocation_snapshot','evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('snapshot_id',(select id from af),'policy_envelope_id',(select admin_policy_envelope_id from af))),
  jsonb_build_object('dependency_code','FINANCE_ADMIN_OVERHEAD','label','Finance/Admin Overhead','scope','SKU_RUN','dimension','EVIDENCE_QUALITY','applicability','APPLICABLE','raw_status',coalesce((select finance_admin_overhead_allocation_status from af),'UNKNOWN'),'effective_status',null,'resolution_source','RUN_SNAPSHOT','reason_code',(select allocation_resolution_status from af),'note',(select finance_admin_overhead_allocation_note from af),'owner_module','COST_BUILD_MANAGER','recommended_ui_route','DRIVER_GOVERNANCE','authority','costing.sku_admin_finance_overhead_allocation_snapshot','evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('snapshot_id',(select id from af),'policy_envelope_id',(select finance_admin_policy_envelope_id from af))),
  jsonb_build_object('dependency_code','MARKETING_EXPENSE','label','Marketing Expense','scope','SKU_RUN','dimension','EVIDENCE_QUALITY','applicability','APPLICABLE','raw_status',coalesce((select marketing_expense_allocation_status from mk),'UNKNOWN'),'effective_status',null,'resolution_source','RUN_SNAPSHOT','reason_code',(select marketing_evidence_status from mk),'note',(select marketing_expense_allocation_note from mk),'owner_module','COST_BUILD_MANAGER','recommended_ui_route','DRIVER_GOVERNANCE','authority','costing.sku_marketing_expense_allocation_snapshot','evidence_ids',jsonb_build_object('snapshot_id',(select id from mk),'policy_id',(select marketing_policy_id from mk),'policy_envelope_id',(select marketing_policy_envelope_id from mk)))
 ),
 'scheme_evidence',(select rows from scheme),
 'scheme_status',case when (select n from scheme)=0 then 'UNKNOWN' when coalesce((select bad from scheme),false) then 'BLOCKED' else 'READY' end,
 'regional_marketing_evidence',(select rows from regional),
 'regional_marketing_status',case when (select n from regional)=0 then 'UNKNOWN' when coalesce((select blocked from regional),false) then 'BLOCKED' when coalesce((select review from regional),false) then 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' else 'READY' end
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_regional_marketing_evidence_fingerprint(p_sku_id bigint, p_product_id bigint, p_region_code text, p_valuation_date date, p_regional_basis_source text, p_resolved_regional_units numeric, p_resolved_regional_base_qty numeric, p_regional_assumption_id bigint, p_regional_default_policy_id bigint, p_regional_default_scenario text, p_marketing_value_source text, p_resolved_product_region_marketing_sales_value numeric, p_marketing_expense_cost_per_sku_region numeric)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
select md5(concat_ws('|',
  coalesce(p_sku_id::text,'∅'),coalesce(p_product_id::text,'∅'),coalesce(upper(btrim(p_region_code)),'∅'),
  coalesce(p_valuation_date::text,'∅'),coalesce(p_regional_basis_source,'∅'),
  coalesce(p_resolved_regional_units::text,'∅'),coalesce(p_resolved_regional_base_qty::text,'∅'),
  coalesce(p_regional_assumption_id::text,'∅'),coalesce(p_regional_default_policy_id::text,'∅'),
  coalesce(p_regional_default_scenario,'∅'),coalesce(p_marketing_value_source,'∅'),
  coalesce(p_resolved_product_region_marketing_sales_value::text,'∅'),
  coalesce(p_marketing_expense_cost_per_sku_region::text,'∅')
));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_regional_marketing_review_status(p_regional_marketing_snapshot_id bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(raw_status text, effective_status text, acceptance_id bigint, evidence_fingerprint text, is_acceptance_eligible boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with s as (
  select e.*,b.regional_assumption_id,b.regional_default_policy_id,b.regional_default_scenario,
    costing.fn_regional_marketing_evidence_fingerprint(
      e.sku_id,e.product_id,e.region_code,e.valuation_date,e.regional_basis_source,
      e.resolved_regional_units,e.resolved_regional_base_qty,b.regional_assumption_id,
      b.regional_default_policy_id,b.regional_default_scenario,e.marketing_value_source,
      e.resolved_product_region_marketing_sales_value,e.marketing_expense_cost_per_sku_region
    ) fp,
    (
      e.marketing_expense_allocation_status='REVIEW_REQUIRED'
      and (
        e.regional_basis_source in ('REGION_SCALED_COMMON_BASIS','REGIONAL_DEFAULT_POLICY_UNITS','REGIONAL_ASSUMPTION_UNITS')
        or e.marketing_value_source in ('GOVERNED_REGIONAL_DEFAULT','APPROVED_REGIONAL_ASSUMPTION')
      )
      and not (e.marketing_value_source='ACTUAL_SIGNED_BILLED_SALES' and coalesce(e.resolved_product_region_marketing_sales_value,0)<=0)
    ) eligible
  from costing.sku_regional_marketing_expense_allocation_snapshot e
  join costing.sku_regional_marketing_allocation_basis_snapshot b on b.id=e.regional_basis_snapshot_id
  where e.id=p_regional_marketing_snapshot_id
), a as (
  select a.id
  from s join costing.regional_marketing_evidence_acceptance a
    on a.period_start=s.period_start
   and a.source_valuation_date=s.valuation_date
   and a.sku_id=s.sku_id
   and a.region_code=s.region_code
   and a.evidence_fingerprint=s.fp
   and a.acceptance_status='ACTIVE'
  order by a.accepted_at desc,a.id desc limit 1
)
select s.marketing_expense_allocation_status,
       case when s.marketing_expense_allocation_status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' and s.eligible and a.id is not null then 'READY'
            else s.marketing_expense_allocation_status end,
       a.id,s.fp,s.eligible
from s left join a on true;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_direct_labour_workload_policy(p_as_of_date date)
 RETURNS costing.direct_labour_workload_policy
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_policy costing.direct_labour_workload_policy%rowtype; v_count integer;
begin
  if p_as_of_date is null then raise exception 'as_of_date is required'; end if;
  select count(*) into v_count
  from costing.direct_labour_workload_policy p
  where p.status='APPROVED'
    and p.effective_from<=p_as_of_date
    and (p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to>=p_as_of_date);
  if v_count<>1 then
    raise exception 'Exactly one approved Direct Labour workload policy must resolve for %, found %',p_as_of_date,v_count;
  end if;
  select * into v_policy
  from costing.direct_labour_workload_policy p
  where p.status='APPROVED'
    and p.effective_from<=p_as_of_date
    and (p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to>=p_as_of_date)
  order by p.effective_from desc,p.policy_version desc,p.id desc
  limit 1;
  return v_policy;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_effective_product_process_route(p_product_id integer, p_as_of_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_date date := coalesce(p_as_of_date,current_date);
  v_count integer;
  v_id bigint;
begin
  select count(*), min(r.id)
  into v_count,v_id
  from costing.product_process_route r
  where r.product_id=p_product_id
    and r.archived_at is null
    and r.status='APPROVED'
    and r.effective_from<=v_date
    and (r.effective_to is null or r.effective_to>=v_date);

  if v_count>1 then
    raise exception 'AMBIGUOUS_APPROVED_PRODUCT_ROUTE for Product % as of %',p_product_id,v_date;
  end if;
  return v_id;
end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_marketing_allocation_policy(p_valuation_date date)
 RETURNS costing.marketing_allocation_policy
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_policy costing.marketing_allocation_policy%rowtype; v_count integer;
begin
  if p_valuation_date is null then raise exception 'valuation_date is required'; end if;

  with eligible as (
    select p.*,e.id envelope_id,e.supersedes_envelope_id
    from costing.marketing_allocation_policy p
    join costing.cost_driver_policy_envelope e
      on e.specialised_policy_schema='costing'
     and e.specialised_policy_table='marketing_allocation_policy'
     and e.specialised_policy_id=p.id
     and e.cost_element_code='MARKETING_EXPENSE'
     and e.lifecycle_status='APPROVED'
     and e.effective_from<=p_valuation_date
     and (e.effective_to is null or e.effective_to>=p_valuation_date)
    where p.is_active and p.effective_from<=p_valuation_date
      and (p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to>=p_valuation_date)
  ), current_effective as (
    select x.* from eligible x
    where not exists (
      select 1 from eligible s where s.supersedes_envelope_id=x.envelope_id
    )
  )
  select count(*)::integer into v_count from current_effective;

  if v_count<>1 then
    raise exception 'Exactly one approved effective Marketing allocation policy must resolve for %, found %',p_valuation_date,v_count;
  end if;

  with eligible as (
    select p.*,e.id envelope_id,e.supersedes_envelope_id
    from costing.marketing_allocation_policy p
    join costing.cost_driver_policy_envelope e
      on e.specialised_policy_schema='costing'
     and e.specialised_policy_table='marketing_allocation_policy'
     and e.specialised_policy_id=p.id
     and e.cost_element_code='MARKETING_EXPENSE'
     and e.lifecycle_status='APPROVED'
     and e.effective_from<=p_valuation_date
     and (e.effective_to is null or e.effective_to>=p_valuation_date)
    where p.is_active and p.effective_from<=p_valuation_date
      and (p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to>=p_valuation_date)
  ), current_effective as (
    select x.* from eligible x
    where not exists (
      select 1 from eligible s where s.supersedes_envelope_id=x.envelope_id
    )
  )
  select (jsonb_populate_record(null::costing.marketing_allocation_policy,to_jsonb(c)-'envelope_id'-'supersedes_envelope_id')).*
  into v_policy
  from current_effective c
  order by c.policy_version desc,c.id desc
  limit 1;

  return v_policy;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_route_family_for_product(p_product_id integer, p_as_of_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_date date := coalesce(p_as_of_date,current_date);
  v_product_family bigint;
  v_subgroup_family bigint;
  v_group_family bigint;
begin
  select m.route_family_id
  into v_product_family
  from costing.production_route_family_product_map m
  join costing.production_route_family f on f.id=m.route_family_id
  where m.product_id=p_product_id
    and m.archived_at is null
    and m.status='APPROVED'
    and m.effective_from<=v_date
    and (m.effective_to is null or m.effective_to>=v_date)
    and f.archived_at is null
    and f.status='APPROVED'
    and f.effective_from<=v_date
    and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  order by m.effective_from desc,m.id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_product_family is not null then
    return v_product_family;
  end if;

  select sm.route_family_id
  into v_subgroup_family
  from public.products p
  join costing.production_route_family_product_subgroup_map sm
    on sm.product_subgroup_id=p.sub_group_id
   and sm.archived_at is null
   and sm.status='APPROVED'
   and sm.effective_from<=v_date
   and (sm.effective_to is null or sm.effective_to>=v_date)
  join costing.production_route_family f
    on f.id=sm.route_family_id
   and f.archived_at is null
   and f.status='APPROVED'
   and f.effective_from<=v_date
   and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  where p.id=p_product_id
  order by sm.effective_from desc,sm.id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_subgroup_family is not null then
    return v_subgroup_family;
  end if;

  select gm.route_family_id
  into v_group_family
  from public.products p
  join public.sub_groups sg on sg.id=p.sub_group_id
  join costing.production_route_family_product_group_map gm
    on gm.product_group_id=sg.product_group_id
   and gm.archived_at is null
   and gm.status='APPROVED'
   and gm.effective_from<=v_date
   and (gm.effective_to is null or gm.effective_to>=v_date)
  join costing.production_route_family f
    on f.id=gm.route_family_id
   and f.archived_at is null
   and f.status='APPROVED'
   and f.effective_from<=v_date
   and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  where p.id=p_product_id
  order by gm.effective_from desc,gm.id desc
  limit 1;

  return v_group_family;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_sales_allocation_default_policy_as_of(p_scenario_code text, p_valuation_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(policy_id bigint, scenario_code text, default_sales_units numeric, effective_from date, effective_to date, resolution_status text, qualifying_policy_count bigint, resolution_note text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with n as (
  select upper(btrim(coalesce(p_scenario_code, ''))) as scenario_code,
         p_valuation_date as valuation_date
),
c as (
  select p.*
  from costing.sales_allocation_default_policy p
  cross join n
  where p.scenario_code = n.scenario_code
    and p.status in ('APPROVED', 'CLOSED')
    and p.effective_from <= n.valuation_date
    and (p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to >= n.valuation_date)
),
s as (select count(*)::bigint as n from c)
select
  case when s.n = 1 then c.id end,
  n.scenario_code,
  case when s.n = 1 then c.default_sales_units end,
  case when s.n = 1 then c.effective_from end,
  case when s.n = 1 then c.effective_to end,
  case
    when p_valuation_date is null then 'INVALID_CONTEXT'
    when n.scenario_code not in ('NEW_SKU_EXISTING_PRODUCT', 'NEW_PRODUCT_NO_HISTORY')
      then 'INVALID_SCENARIO'
    when s.n = 0 then 'MISSING'
    when s.n > 1 then 'AMBIGUOUS'
    else 'RESOLVED'
  end,
  s.n,
  case
    when p_valuation_date is null then 'Valuation date is required.'
    when n.scenario_code not in ('NEW_SKU_EXISTING_PRODUCT', 'NEW_PRODUCT_NO_HISTORY')
      then 'Sales-allocation default-policy scenario is invalid.'
    when s.n = 0 then 'No governed scenario policy is effective on the valuation date.'
    when s.n > 1 then 'Multiple governed scenario policies overlap on the valuation date.'
    else format(
      'Company CSA default policy %s supplies %s units for scenario %s.',
      c.id, c.default_sales_units, n.scenario_code
    )
  end
from n
cross join s
left join c on s.n = 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_sku_commercial_sales_basis_point(p_sku_id bigint, p_period_start date, p_valuation_date date)
 RETURNS SETOF costing.v_sku_commercial_sales_basis
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with source_context as materialized (
  select
    sab.period_start,
    cp.valuation_date as management_valuation_date,
    sab.sku_id,
    sab.product_id,
    sab.product_name,
    sab.pack_size,
    sab.pack_uom,
    sab.allocation_basis_status,
    coalesce(sab.actual_sales_units_12m, sab.sales_units_12m) as actual_sales_units_12m,
    coalesce(sab.actual_sales_base_qty_12m, sab.sales_base_qty_12m) as actual_sales_base_qty_12m,
    coalesce(sab.actual_product_sales_units_12m, sab.product_sales_units_12m) as product_sales_units_12m,
    coalesce(sab.actual_product_sales_base_qty_12m, sab.product_sales_base_qty_12m) as product_sales_base_qty_12m,
    sab.product_allocation_share,
    sab.lookback_start,
    sab.lookback_end,
    case
      when coalesce(sab.actual_sales_units_12m, sab.sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric then null::text
      when coalesce(sab.actual_product_sales_units_12m, sab.product_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric then 'NEW_SKU_EXISTING_PRODUCT'::text
      else 'NEW_PRODUCT_NO_HISTORY'::text
    end as required_default_scenario
  from costing.sku_sales_allocation_basis_snapshot sab
  join costing.cost_periods cp on cp.period_start = sab.period_start
  where sab.sku_id = p_sku_id
    and sab.period_start = date_trunc('month', p_period_start::timestamp)::date
    and cp.valuation_date = p_valuation_date
),
resolved_context as (
  select
    s.period_start,
    s.management_valuation_date,
    s.sku_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.product_name,
    s.pack_size,
    s.pack_uom,
    s.allocation_basis_status,
    s.actual_sales_units_12m,
    s.actual_sales_base_qty_12m,
    s.product_sales_units_12m,
    s.product_sales_base_qty_12m,
    s.product_allocation_share,
    s.lookback_start,
    s.lookback_end,
    s.required_default_scenario,
    ar.assumption_id as resolved_assumption_id,
    ar.assumption_basis as resolved_assumption_basis,
    ar.assumed_sales_units as resolved_assumed_sales_units,
    ar.assumed_sales_value as resolved_assumed_sales_value,
    ar.remarks as resolved_assumption_remarks,
    ar.approval_reference as resolved_assumption_approval_reference,
    ar.effective_from as resolved_assumption_effective_from,
    ar.effective_to as resolved_assumption_effective_to,
    ar.resolution_status as assumption_resolution_status,
    ar.qualifying_assumption_count,
    dp.policy_id as resolved_default_policy_id,
    dp.scenario_code as resolved_default_scenario,
    dp.default_sales_units as resolved_default_sales_units,
    dp.effective_from as resolved_default_effective_from,
    dp.effective_to as resolved_default_effective_to,
    dp.resolution_status as default_resolution_status,
    dp.qualifying_policy_count
  from source_context s
  cross join lateral costing.fn_resolve_sku_sales_assumption_as_of(s.period_start, s.sku_id, s.management_valuation_date) ar(
    assumption_id, assumption_basis, assumed_sales_units, assumed_sales_value, remarks, approval_reference,
    effective_from, effective_to, resolution_status, qualifying_assumption_count, resolution_note
  )
  left join lateral costing.fn_resolve_sales_allocation_default_policy_as_of(s.required_default_scenario, s.management_valuation_date) dp(
    policy_id, scenario_code, default_sales_units, effective_from, effective_to, resolution_status, qualifying_policy_count, resolution_note
  ) on s.required_default_scenario is not null
)
select
  period_start,
  sku_id,
  product_id,
  product_name,
  pack_size,
  pack_uom,
  allocation_basis_status,
  actual_sales_units_12m,
  actual_sales_base_qty_12m,
  product_sales_units_12m,
  product_sales_base_qty_12m,
  product_allocation_share,
  lookback_start,
  lookback_end,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumption_id else null::bigint end as assumption_id,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumption_basis else null::text end as manual_assumption_basis,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumed_sales_units else null::numeric end as manual_assumed_sales_units,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumed_sales_value else null::numeric end as manual_assumed_sales_value,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumption_remarks else null::text end as manual_assumption_remarks,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumption_effective_from else null::date end as manual_effective_from,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumption_effective_to else null::date end as manual_effective_to,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then 'ACTIVE'::text else null::text end as manual_assumption_status,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'AMBIGUOUS'::text then 'UNRESOLVED'::text
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumption_basis
    when coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric then 'ACTUAL_12M'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text and required_default_scenario = 'NEW_SKU_EXISTING_PRODUCT'::text then 'DEFAULT_NEW_SKU_EXISTING_PRODUCT'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text and required_default_scenario = 'NEW_PRODUCT_NO_HISTORY'::text then 'DEFAULT_NEW_PRODUCT_NO_HISTORY'::text
    else 'UNRESOLVED'::text
  end as commercial_sales_basis,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'AMBIGUOUS'::text then null::numeric
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumed_sales_units
    when coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric then actual_sales_units_12m
    when default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_default_sales_units
    else null::numeric
  end as commercial_sales_units,
  case when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_assumed_sales_value else null::numeric end as commercial_sales_value,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then 'MANUAL'::text
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'AMBIGUOUS'::text then 'SYSTEM_WARNING'::text
    when coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric then 'SYSTEM'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then 'SYSTEM'::text
    else 'SYSTEM_WARNING'::text
  end as assumption_source,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'AMBIGUOUS'::text then 'Commercial sales basis is blocked because multiple SKU assumptions overlap on the governed valuation date.'::text
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then 'A governed SKU-specific commercial sales assumption is effective on the governed valuation date.'::text
    when coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric then 'Positive cleaned 12-month SKU sales are used.'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'AMBIGUOUS'::text then 'Commercial sales basis is blocked because multiple governed default policies overlap on the valuation date.'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'MISSING'::text then 'No governed default sales-allocation policy is effective on the valuation date.'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text and required_default_scenario = 'NEW_SKU_EXISTING_PRODUCT'::text then 'The SKU has no cleaned sales in the lookback period; the governed new-SKU default quantity is used.'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text and required_default_scenario = 'NEW_PRODUCT_NO_HISTORY'::text then 'The product has no cleaned sales in the lookback period; the governed new-product default quantity is used.'::text
    else 'Commercial sales basis could not be resolved.'::text
  end as commercial_sales_warning,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'AMBIGUOUS'::text then 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
    when coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric then 'OK'::text
    when default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then 'DEFAULTED'::text
    else 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'::text
  end as commercial_sales_status,
  management_valuation_date,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'MISSING'::text and coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric and default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_default_policy_id
    else null::bigint
  end as default_policy_id,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'MISSING'::text and coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric and default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_default_scenario
    else null::text
  end as default_policy_scenario,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'MISSING'::text and coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric and default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_default_sales_units
    else null::numeric
  end as default_sales_units,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'MISSING'::text and coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric and default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_default_effective_from
    else null::date
  end as default_policy_effective_from,
  case
    when assumption_resolution_status = 'MISSING'::text and coalesce(actual_sales_units_12m, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric and default_resolution_status = 'RESOLVED'::text then resolved_default_effective_to
    else null::date
  end as default_policy_effective_to,
  resolved_assumption_approval_reference as manual_assumption_approval_reference,
  assumption_resolution_status,
  default_resolution_status
from resolved_context;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_sku_sales_assumption_as_of(p_period_start date, p_sku_id bigint, p_valuation_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(assumption_id bigint, assumption_basis text, assumed_sales_units numeric, assumed_sales_value numeric, remarks text, approval_reference text, effective_from date, effective_to date, resolution_status text, qualifying_assumption_count bigint, resolution_note text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with context as (
    select
        date_trunc(
            'month',
            p_period_start
        )::date as period_start,
        p_sku_id as sku_id,
        p_valuation_date as valuation_date
),
candidates as (
    select
        a.id,
        a.assumption_basis,
        a.assumed_sales_units,
        a.assumed_sales_value,
        a.remarks,
        a.approval_reference,
        a.effective_from,
        a.effective_to
    from costing.sku_commercial_sales_assumption a
    cross join context c
    where a.period_start = c.period_start
      and a.sku_id = c.sku_id
      and a.status = 'ACTIVE'
      and a.effective_from <= c.valuation_date
      and (
            a.effective_to is null
            or a.effective_to >= c.valuation_date
          )
),
summary as (
    select count(*)::bigint as qualifying_count
    from candidates
)
select
    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.id
        else null::bigint
    end,

    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.assumption_basis
        else null::text
    end,

    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.assumed_sales_units
        else null::numeric
    end,

    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.assumed_sales_value
        else null::numeric
    end,

    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.remarks
        else null::text
    end,

    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.approval_reference
        else null::text
    end,

    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.effective_from
        else null::date
    end,

    case
        when s.qualifying_count = 1
            then c.effective_to
        else null::date
    end,

    case
        when p_period_start is null
          or p_sku_id is null
          or p_valuation_date is null
            then 'INVALID_CONTEXT'

        when s.qualifying_count = 0
            then 'MISSING'

        when s.qualifying_count > 1
            then 'AMBIGUOUS'

        else 'RESOLVED'
    end,

    s.qualifying_count,

    case
        when p_period_start is null
          or p_sku_id is null
          or p_valuation_date is null
            then
                'Period, SKU and valuation date are required.'

        when s.qualifying_count = 0
            then
                'No active SKU allocation-volume assumption is effective on the valuation date.'

        when s.qualifying_count > 1
            then
                'Multiple active SKU allocation-volume assumptions overlap on the valuation date.'

        else
            'SKU allocation-volume assumption resolved.'
    end

from summary s
left join candidates c
  on s.qualifying_count = 1;
$function$
